name: Adaptive Tensor Field Segmentation via Edge-Weighted Refinement
aliases: Tensor Field Segmentation via Edge-Weighted Coarsening and Subdivision
definition: An adaptive refinement method for segmenting tensor fields into cells of varying size based on geometric and scalar field similarity, using edge-weighted priority queues for coarsening and subdivision operations to maintain mesh validity (avoiding hanging nodes).
summary: Adaptive Tensor Field Segmentation via Edge-Weighted Refinement is a topology-based method for visualizing 2D symmetric tensor fields that refines initial pre-segmentations by merging or splitting cells using edge-weighted priority queues to maintain mesh validity and enable focus-plus-context visualization.
